## Summary

<!-- What does this change and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] New effect or recipe
- [ ] Fix to an existing example
- [ ] Gallery, starter or tooling change
- [ ] Documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] `npm run test:stories` and `npm run test:browser` pass
- [ ] New or changed examples have Default, Paused and Fallback stories
- [ ] Reduced-motion, pause and capability fallbacks still work
- [ ] Source and licence records (`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, `docs/RECIPE_SOURCES.md`, `licenses/`) are updated
- [ ] Screenshots attached if appearance changed
- [ ] No credentials, telemetry or remote assets added
